content: Guided walkthrough for v3.0 release covering 8 parts: (1) big picture architecture change — review pipeline now has discovery and verification phases, (2) review pipeline step-by-step with invariants, (3) REVIEW.md convention and prompt injection defense, (4) three new agents — finding-validator conservative filtering, compliance-auditor exact quotation, history-analyst deep-mode-only, (5) infrastructure scripts — bump_version regex-not-TOML design, enforce_forgetting_curve dual thresholds with SQLite-first fallback and path traversal defense, unify_sightings Rule of Three bridging, (6) ship automation classification logic referencing policy docs, (7) pre-commit hook fixed-string grep and 5-min cache, (8) test invariants including agent count guard and formatting preservation. Five key design decisions highlighted for quiz prep.
